ExamPdfBatch.title: ExamPdfBatch
ExamPdfBatch.description: Metadata record for an uploaded Q&A PDF file whose extracted questions were added to the shared exam bank.

userId.description: Firebase UID of the user who uploaded the Q&A PDF.

title.description: Exam batch title derived from the PDF or customized by uploader.

pageCount.description: Number of pages scanned from the PDF.

questionCount.description: Total number of questions imported from this PDF.

mcqCount.description: Number of MCQ questions in this batch.

fillCount.description: Number of fill-in-the-blank questions in this batch.

descriptiveCount.description: Number of descriptive written questions in this batch.

visibility.description: Visibility partition key matching security rule list queries.

ExamQuestion.title: ExamQuestion
ExamQuestion.description: Individual exam question extracted from an uploaded Q&A PDF (MCQ, fill-in-the-blank, or descriptive).

batchTitle.description: Title of the source PDF batch.

orderIndex.description: Sequence index within the source PDF.

prompt.description: Question text shown to exam candidates.

options.description: Multiple choice option labels for MCQ questions (empty for other types).

correctOptionIndex.description: Zero-based index of the correct MCQ option, or -1 for non-MCQ.

correctAnswer.description: Reference answer or model description extracted from the Q&A PDF for grading.

marks.description: Maximum marks awarded for a fully correct answer.

active.description: Whether this question is included in active exams.

visibility.description: Visibility partition key matching security rule list queries.

ExamSubmission.title: ExamSubmission
ExamSubmission.description: Candidate exam submission summary used to compute total candidates and live rankings.

candidateName.description: Candidate full name entered at exam start.

phase.description: Candidate program or phase (e.g., AQC - 10th Phase).

obtainedMarks.description: Total marks awarded across MCQ, fill-in-the-blank, and AI-graded descriptive answers.

totalMarks.description: Maximum possible marks for the attempted exam.

questionCount.description: Total number of questions in this exam attempt.

mcqCorrect.description: Count of correctly answered MCQ questions.

descMarks.description: AI-graded marks earned on descriptive written answers.

ExamReview.title: ExamReview
ExamReview.description: Owner-only detailed per-question answer review and AI grading feedback for an exam submission.

items.description: List of graded question review maps.

DisabledCoordinator.title: DisabledCoordinator
DisabledCoordinator.description: Coordinator UID whose Q&A PDF upload permission has been revoked by Super Admin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the blocked coordinator.

name.description: Coordinator label shown in Super Admin batch list.

blockedByUid.description: Super Admin Firebase UID who applied the block.

SuperAdminGrant.title: SuperAdminGrant
SuperAdminGrant.description: Delegated Super Admin email record managed by Root or existing Super Admins.

email.description: Normalized lowercase staff email granted Super Admin access.

addedByEmail.description: Email of the Super Admin who granted access.

addedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Super Admin who granted access.

/examPdfBatches/{batchId}.description: Uploaded Q&A PDF batches forming the exam question bank.

/examQuestions/{questionId}.description: Exam questions parsed from uploaded Q&A PDFs.

/examSubmissions/{submissionId}.description: Candidate exam scores and metadata for live rank calculation across total candidates.

/users/{userId}/examReviews/{submissionI.description: Private per-question answer breakdown and AI feedback scoped to the submitting user.

/disabledCoordinators/{uid}.description: Blocked Coordinator UIDs managed exclusively by Super Admin.

/superAdmins/{email}.description: Delegated Super Admin email grants managed by Super Admins; mrlalon@bsreader.local remains permanent root fallback.
